name: context-inspector
description: See the exact text behind each part of Cursor's agent Context Usage, and keep a local history of agent sessions.

cursorContextInspector.databasePath.description: Path to Cursor's state.vscdb. Empty = detect automatically.

cursorContextInspector.showStatusBarItem.description: Show a "Context" button in the status bar.

cursorContextInspector.recordHistory.description: Keep a local history of agent sessions: every prompt message and a snapshot per chat update.

cursorContextInspector.historyDirectory.description: Where session history is stored. Empty = ~/.cursor-context-history.

enumDescriptions: The messages and the readable conversation (chat.md) only.
Also the agent's readable thinking, the raw transcript.md and a token-breakdown snapshot per chat update.
Everything: also a snapshot per model call and turn end, the context sent outside the prompt (rules, skills, MCP tools), and replaced tool results and interrupted replies found in Cursor's store.
cursorContextInspector.historyDetail.description: How much detail the session history records. Applies to what is recorded from now on; detail already recorded is kept.

cursorContextInspector.recordOnAgentStop.description: Record a chat as soon as the agent finishes its turn, through a stop hook this extension adds to ~/.cursor/hooks.json (your other hooks are kept). Off: the hook is removed and chats are recorded every 30 s only. Applies after Reload Window.

cursorContextInspector.historyBackfillDa.description: Also record older chats, updated in this many past days; 0 = every chat Cursor still has. Caught up in the background, a few at a time.
